name: Band Single-Arm Rotational Chest Press
steps: Sit tall on the floor with your legs extended and a resistance band anchored behind and slightly to one side at chest height.
Hold the band in your nearer hand beside your chest with your elbow back and core braced.
Press your hand forward and across your midline while rotating your chest smoothly away from the anchor.
Unwind and bend your elbow slowly back beside your chest, then reposition and switch sides after finishing one arm.
tips: Keep both hips grounded flat on the floor as your torso rotates.
Drive the rotation through your chest and obliques rather than shrugging your shoulder.
